_comment: Optional telecom employers whose own careers feed is read directly (same format and ATS support as the main board's config/employers.json: greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, personio, workday). Board ids are NOT guessed here. Add a line after checking the employer's careers page, e.g. { "name": "Acme Telecom", "ats": "workday", "host": "acme.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com", "site": "Careers", "country": "GB", "local": true }. Failing employers are listed on the page under Source status. Entries with "enabled": false are recorded but not read: BT, Vodafone and Virgin Media O2 use career-site platforms the shared connectors do not support yet.

employers.name: BT Group
employers.note: Career site runs on SAP SuccessFactors (jobs.bt.com/BTGroup/job/...). No connector yet; many BT OSS roles are in India, so filter to UK.

employers.name: Vodafone
employers.note: opportunities.vodafone.com (SuccessFactors-style URLs) and vodafone.eightfold.ai. No connector yet; OSS/BSS roles found so far were in Pune.
